data.title: List provinces
data.description: Retrieve all level-1 administrative divisions for Cambodia or Laos.
data.body:
```http
GET /tms-partner/api/v1/administrativedivision/country/{country-code}
```

## Usage and important notes

Use `KH` for Cambodia and `LA` for Laos. The result is an array, not a paginated object. Save both `id` and `code`; `code` is the next request’s `location-code`. `status=1` means active. Names may change with `Accept-Language`.

## Authentication headers



| Header | Requirement | Value / meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| X-Api-Token | Required | `${API_TOKEN}`: environment-specific token issued by TMS |
| X-Client-Source | Required | `${PARTNER_CODE}`: partner code paired with the token |
| Content-Type | With a JSON body | application/json |
| Accept | Required by source | application/json |
| Accept-Language | Optional | `vn`, `en`, `my`, `km`, `lo` |



## Path and query parameters



| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| country-code | path | Yes | ISO country code: KH Cambodia, LA Laos. |



## cURL example

`BASE_URL` must include `/tms-partner/api/v1`. Load the token and partner code from your private environment; never paste secrets into documentation or AI prompts.
```bash
curl --request GET "${BASE_URL}/administrativedivision/country/KH" \
  --header "X-Api-Token: ${API_TOKEN}" \
  --header "X-Client-Source: ${PARTNER_CODE}" \
  --header "Accept-Language: en" \
  --header "Accept: application/json"
```


## Example response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 4025109,
    "level": 1,
    "status": 1,
    "code": "BAN",
    "countrycode": "KH",
    "name": "Banteay Meanchey",
    "type": "PROVINCE",
    "short_name": "Banteay Meanchey",
    "parent_code": "KH",
    "refs": [
      {
        "sys": "VTP",
        "code": "BAN"
      },
      {
        "sys": "POSTCODE",
        "code": "01"
      }
    ]
  }
]
```


## Response fields



| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[].id` | number | See description | Internal location ID. |
| `[].level` | number | See description | Administrative level: 1 province, 2 district, 3 village. |
| `[].status` | number | See description | 1 means active. |
| `[].code` | string | See description | Use the identifier returned by the API, not the illustrative value. |
| `[].countrycode` | string | See description | Country code. |
| `[].name` | string | See description | Localized location name. |
| `[].type` | string | See description | PROVINCE, DISTRICT or VILLAGE. |
| `[].short_name` | string | See description | Short name. |
| `[].parent_code` | string | See description | Parent location code; generally country code at level 1. |
| `[].refs` | array | See description | References to other systems. |
| `[].refs[].sys` | string | See description | Reference system, e.g. VTP or POSTCODE. |
| `[].refs[].code` | string | See description | Use the identifier returned by the API, not the illustrative value. |



## Error handling

See [HTTP codes and source limitations](reference). HTTP success does not prove COD, fees, or cancellation are correct; inspect the documented business fields. Do not assume create-order retries are safe.

data.title: Tổng quan tích hợp
data.description: Xác thực, chọn môi trường và thực hiện quy trình vận chuyển Metfone Express đầy đủ.
data.body:
## Xác thực và môi trường



| Header | Yêu cầu | Giá trị / ý nghĩa |
| --- | --- | --- |
| X-Api-Token | Bắt buộc | `${API_TOKEN}`: token riêng theo môi trường do TMS cấp |
| X-Client-Source | Bắt buộc | `${PARTNER_CODE}`: mã đối tác khớp với token |
| Content-Type | Khi có body JSON | application/json |
| Accept | Bắt buộc theo nguồn | application/json |
| Accept-Language | Tùy chọn | `vn`, `en`, `my`, `km`, `lo` |

Liên hệ bộ phận kỹ thuật TMS để nhận cặp token/mã đối tác riêng cho sandbox và production. Không dùng chéo môi trường. Giao diện dùng locale `vi`, còn hợp đồng `Accept-Language` dùng `vn`; một số ví dụ nguồn dùng `vi` nên cần xác nhận với nhà cung cấp. Khmer, Lào và Myanmar có giao diện dịch; khi tài liệu chưa dịch, cổng hiển thị ngôn ngữ thực của trang và thông báo fallback.

```bash
export BASE_URL="https://dev-gw.metfone.com.kh/tms-partner/api/v1"
# API_TOKEN and PARTNER_CODE must be supplied by your private environment.
# Never put production secrets into examples or AI prompts.
```

## Lộ trình tích hợp

1. [Lấy tỉnh](provinces), rồi [huyện/xã](administrative-divisions); lưu id/code thật.
2. [Tra bưu cục](post-offices) nếu cần gửi/nhận tại bưu cục.
3. [Lấy dịch vụ](available-services) phù hợp tuyến đường và hàng hóa.
4. [Tính giá](calculate-pricing) với mã dịch vụ đã chọn.
5. [Tạo đơn](create-order), **truyền lại moneyCollection**, đối chiếu cod và lưu phản hồi.
6. [Tạo template](create-label) rồi [tải nhãn HTML](print-label) trước khi hết hạn.
7. [Nhận webhook](webhook-status), [tra trạng thái](order-status) khi cần; chỉ [hủy](cancel-order) nếu đủ điều kiện.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A["Địa chỉ"] --> B["Dịch vụ"]
  A --> P["Bưu cục tùy chọn"]
  B --> C["Tính cước"]
  C --> D["Tạo đơn và COD"]
  D --> E["Template nhãn"]
  E --> F["HTML để in"]
  D --> G["Webhook hành trình"]
  D --> H["Tra trạng thái"]
```

## Trình tự request


```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant P as Đối tác
  participant T as TMS Partner
  P->>T: GET địa chỉ cấp 1, 2, 3
  T-->>P: id và code
  P->>T: POST pricing/get-service
  T-->>P: Mã dịch vụ và cờ lựa chọn
  P->>T: POST pricing/get-all
  T-->>P: Chi tiết phí trước VAT
  P->>T: POST order với moneyCollection
  T-->>P: id, cod, phản hồi đầy đủ
  P->>T: POST order/label/presigned
  T-->>P: securePath, exp
  P->>T: GET order/label/securePath
  T-->>P: text/html
  T->>P: POST webhook cập nhật trạng thái
  P-->>T: HTTP 200 xác nhận tiếp nhận
```

data.title: Integration overview
data.description: Authenticate, choose an environment, and follow the complete Metfone Express shipping workflow.
data.body:
## Authentication and environments



| Header | Requirement | Value / meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| X-Api-Token | Required | `${API_TOKEN}`: environment-specific token issued by TMS |
| X-Client-Source | Required | `${PARTNER_CODE}`: partner code paired with the token |
| Content-Type | With a JSON body | application/json |
| Accept | Required by source | application/json |
| Accept-Language | Optional | `vn`, `en`, `my`, `km`, `lo` |

Contact TMS technical support for separate token/partner-code pairs for sandbox and production. Do not mix environments. The portal locale is `vi`, but the declared `Accept-Language` value is `vn`; several source examples use `vi`, so confirm provider behavior. Khmer, Lao, and Burmese have translated interfaces; missing document translations disclose the actual page language and fallback.

```bash
export BASE_URL="https://dev-gw.metfone.com.kh/tms-partner/api/v1"
# API_TOKEN and PARTNER_CODE must be supplied by your private environment.
# Never put production secrets into examples or AI prompts.
```

## Integration journey

1. [Load provinces](provinces), then [districts/villages](administrative-divisions); retain current IDs/codes.
2. [Find a post office](post-offices) if branch drop-off/collection is needed.
3. [Discover services](available-services) for the route and goods.
4. [Calculate prices](calculate-pricing) for selected service codes.
5. [Create the order](create-order), **resend moneyCollection**, compare cod, and save the response.
6. [Create a template](create-label), then [retrieve HTML](print-label) before expiry.
7. [Receive webhooks](webhook-status), [look up status](order-status) as needed; [cancel](cancel-order) only when eligible.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A["Addresses"] --> B["Services"]
  A --> P["Optional post office"]
  B --> C["Pricing"]
  C --> D["Order and COD"]
  D --> E["Label template"]
  E --> F["Printable HTML"]
  D --> G["Journey webhooks"]
  D --> H["Status lookup"]
```

## Request sequence


```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant P as Partner
  participant T as TMS Partner
  P->>T: GET address levels 1, 2, 3
  T-->>P: IDs and codes
  P->>T: POST pricing/get-service
  T-->>P: Service codes and selection flags
  P->>T: POST pricing/get-all
  T-->>P: Pre-VAT fee breakdown
  P->>T: POST order with moneyCollection
  T-->>P: id, cod, full creation response
  P->>T: POST order/label/presigned
  T-->>P: securePath, exp
  P->>T: GET order/label/securePath
  T-->>P: text/html
  T->>P: POST status webhook
  P-->>T: HTTP 200 receipt acknowledgement
```
